title: Translation-adjusted one-sided Hayes endpoint ledger
statement: At each binary Hayes level j, removing every translation-forced spectral zero from the individual Weil term gives the proved envelope (2^(j-1)-z_(j,n))(j-1)2^ceil(n/2). Recomputing the selected one-sided connected-trace ledger with these envelopes never increases its required saving. At (ell,n)=(200,401), the adjustment removes 2^94 low-window and 31*2^94 top-window characters but leaves the required integer saving equal to 626. At (200,402), it removes none and leaves the ledger unchanged.

evidence.supports: Exact low/top envelope subtraction, allowance recomputation, first-endpoint counts, and monotonicity through level 1024.
evidence.notes: This establishes only the improved ledger. It supplies no estimate for the residual signed trace and no evidence for REL itself.

provenance.source: ADR-0588 exact zeros inserted into the ADR-0572 one-sided endpoint ledger

notes: The first odd endpoint still requires saving 626; the even endpoint is unchanged. WITT-LOW and REL remain open.
